name: review-response
title: Review Response
summary: Verify review feedback against the codebase, then implement or push back with technical reasoning; gate tests on explicit authorization and report unrun verification honestly.

use_when: You received review comments, change requests, or feedback on code you produced
Feedback seems unclear, partially understood, or technically questionable
Multiple feedback items need ordering and individual verification
avoid_when: You are performing the review — use pr-review or code-review
The feedback reports a failure whose root cause is unknown — use debugging
The feedback requires new behavior — implement under test-driven-development
